name: hud_sensor_tracker_command_show_objective_pickup_info
description: HudSensorTracker::Command_ShowObjectivePickupInfo plays the objective review click, toggles pickup-info visibility from the current objective UI mode, and forwards the local player's active alt weapon opt-catalog entry to ShowObjectivePickupInfo. Direct production host: mission.cpp.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the coherent HudSensorTracker objective-command cluster because this wrapper depends on global player-state layout, sound-provider behavior, and command-call context.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4188f0 validates the objectiveReviewSfx zSndSample::PlayA3DSimple call, the visibility toggle when objectiveUiMode is 3 or 4, loading g_GameStateOrMapTable->playerState->activeAltGunController->optCatalogEntry, and the call to HudSensorTracker::ShowObjectivePickupInfo with startAutoAdvance set to zero.
The native objective-pickup smoke verifies command-show from a non-pickup UI mode and command-hide from pickup-info mode through a local player-state fixture with an active alt-gun opt-catalog entry.
